description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView for managing wake word settings, including adding, deleting, and resetting wake words, as well as persisting and synchronizing changes.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for editing and managing voice wake words, with features to add, delete, reset to defaults, and synchronize with app model.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding for a specific trigger word at given index.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves current trigger words, sanitizes them, and updates the global wake words with a delay.
